svg.text: One double shot through a fictional prosumer machine, every device on one clock
Timings are illustrative — the vocabulary is the point.
Figure 1 — One double shot, fully accounted
18 g in, 36 g out: who moves when, and on whose say-so.
The two instants a human is involved: asking for the shot, and being told it is done.
Burr motor run — individual revolutions are far too fast to resolve at this scale.
Low-pressure pre-infusion, a ramp, then flat nine bar until the scale calls the stop.
The PID holds the setpoint with a slow duty train; the true loop is thermal, not per-
Open exactly while the pump runs, so pressure has one path: through the puck.
Nothing lands until the puck saturates; the last gram arrives after the pump stops.
36 g target — 1:2 from an 18 g dose
